Method of Attack: Showing fake security alerts to trick users
Displaying intrusive ads on notification clicks
Secretly collecting extensive personal and device data
Avoiding running on modern devices with improved security
Not creating shortcut icons to hinder uninstallation
Impacted Systems: Android devices excluding modern models such as Google Nexus 6P, Xiaomi MI 4LTE, ZTE N958St, LGE LG-H525n
Attack Vector: Malicious Android apps distributed via Google Play Store
Indicators of Compromise: Fake security alerts in notification bar
Intrusive ads triggered by notification clicks
Long EULA disclosing intrusive data collection unrelated to app functionality
